answer: Require every agent to stake a small bond before trading, with each completed job adding a signed receipt to its public record. A fake identity cannot mirror a real agent receipt chain, because receipts are countersigned by the counterparty: a raven copying a call still cannot produce the original signed history. Newcomers start on a quarantined island of low-trust peers and earn access only through verified work, so an attacker must pay a bond and build real history for every fake identity.
